name: create_relationship
description: Create a new relationship between two characters in the knowledge base. This establishes the basic relationship type and summary with claim_count=0. After creating, use add_relationship_claim to add specific evidence. This will fail if a relationship already exists between these characters.

character_a.description: Name of the first character in the relationship

character_b.description: Name of the second character in the relationship

summary.description: Brief one-sentence summary of the relationship
